maya: Heads-up — saw a repro where a transport stall during a long prefill + streaming handoff results in duplicated tokens around the context window boundary (~32768).
cheng: ugh seen that once, have logs?
maya: pasted the relevant snippet below, it's tiny but consistent across 3 seeds:
cheng: ```
[2026-03-19T14:02:11Z] PREFILL len=32758 id=req-42
[2026-03-19T14:02:11Z] stream handoff start id=req-42
[2026-03-19T14:02:11Z] transport stall (client retry)
[2026-03-19T14:02:12Z] reconnect, resume stream id=req-42
[2026-03-19T14:02:12Z] KVCACHE index=32758 -> replay start=32758
[2026-03-19T14:02:12Z] tokens emitted 32758..32764
[2026-03-19T14:02:12Z] tokens emitted 32758..32764  <-- duplicate block
```
anya: Are you still on int8 quantization builds? we had one bug where memcpy alignment + rope exponent wrap combined badly.
maya: yes int8-v2 build. Also model is using RoPE rescale (rescale=1.5) for longcontext.
alex: quick hypothesis: when transport stalls we trigger a partial prefill replay path that reconstructs KV from shard snapshots, but the replay loop doesn't advance the head pointer before a duplicate flush — race between resume path and streaming token emission. plus RoPE phase wrap can make the tokenizer offsets look legit so we don't detect duplicates.
maya: that fits — duplication always a contiguous chunk matching the replay block size.
cheng: repro script I used:
```bash
./tools/smoke_replay.sh --model magnet-14b --quant int8v2 --prefill 32758 --handoff-delay 100ms --inject-transport-failure
```
maya: results: 3/10 runs show dup block, 7/10 clean. Non-deterministic but correlated with short stalls.
ops-bot: deploy 2026-03-19T15:00 UTC scheduled: onboard/quant-int8v2-hotfix -> test cluster (notify #eng-ml).
anya: mitigation ideas: 1) make resume path re-run a lightweight KV-consistency check (compare fingerprint per-shard) before emitting, 2) switch to atomic head advance on replay, 3) add a dup-detect in streamer that checks last-k tokens against KV replay batch.
alex: can we add a cheap fingerprint (xor64 over keys) to snapshot metadata? compute cost is negligible and it would catch partial replays.
cheng: I can add fingerprinting in snapshotter and add a fast check in resume path. I'll also try toggling RoPE rescale to 1.0 to see if it reduces false acceptance.
maya: test matrix I propose:
- baseline (int8v2, rescale=1.5) with inject-transport-failure x20
- rescale=1.0 same x20
- float32 (no quant) same x10
- resume-with-fingerprint enabled x20
Please record seed + timestamps.
anya: I'll owner the dashboard to track dup-rate and assign an alert if >1% occurrences in nightly smoke.
alex: small quick-check command to detect dup chunks locally (run on captured output):
```python
# look for repeated contiguous ranges
for i in range(len(tokens)-6):
    if tokens[i:i+7]==tokens[i+7:i+14]:
        print('dup at', i)
```
maya: assigning: cheng -> add fingerprint and resume-check, alex -> add streamer dup-safety guard, anya -> alert/dash, maya -> run matrix and collate seeds. I'll update this thread with links to runs.
cheng: started a PR branch `kv-resume-fp` and uploaded initial perf numbers (cost <0.5ms/shard). linking in a sec.
maya: thanks all, will kick off the first batch now and report back with a run id. :thumbsup:
